title: Filters can get broken on un-claim

issues.title: Filters can get broken on un-claim
issues.body:
A senior player (with "un-claim" permissions) need to un-claim an RFI.

Since there were lots of RFIs, he applied a filter for that role.  But, once the document was un-claimed, the filter was disabled - so he was unable to de-select the filter for that role.

Steps to reproduce:
* Login as Red http://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kskl1i3t&access=pkskl17thb
* Submit an RFI into Red RFI
* Now submit another RFI to Red RFI
* Login as white player: http://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kskl1i3t&access=pkskl17ti
* Go to Red RFI channel 
* Claim an RFI
* Login as J2A: http://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kskl1i3t&access=rkskl61c3
* Go to Red RFI channel 
* Claim an RFI
* There will now be two RFIs visible, owned by two different players
* Filter for RFIs owned by `EXCON  J2b`
* Expand the single RFI
* Click on `un-claim`
* The RFI will disappear, and show an empty list. 

* This is because we're still filtering by "owner is J2B2 - but there are no "J2B" RFISs. We aren't offered the filter for that list because there aren't enough visible RFIs.  Serge decides whether to display a filter based on the number of visible rows.  That test needs to be "number of rows > 1" or "filter has been applied".
